_comment: AN EXAMPLE, NOT LOADED BY THE GAME (only *.json directly in data/story/ are). It shows every part of the story format (quests, scenes, talk and a key hunt: a story contract) with things that already exist (the clerk, the trainer, the librarian, an old key) and no new lore. Copy it up a folder to try it in play. See data/story/_README.md.

example_errand.title: The clerk's errand

stages.log: A note was left for you: the guild clerk wants a word.
stages.goal: Speak to the guild clerk in the hall.

stages.log: The clerk lost a key out at [Quiet][Green][Daybreak], and wants it back.
stages.goal: Find the clerk's old key at [Quiet][Green][Daybreak] (it's in the second area).
Take the key back to the clerk.

example_errand.done_log: The clerk has the key back.

example_dogs.title: Dog trouble

stages.log: The trainer says the wild dogs at [Quiet][Green][Daybreak] have grown bold.
stages.goal: Kill three wild dogs ({example_dogs} so far).

example_dogs.done_log: Three dogs fewer. The trainer will be pleased.

example_proving.title: A key hunt

stages.log: The clerk has posted a key hunt for you on the contracts board: something old, with something big guarding it.
stages.goal: Take the key hunt from the contracts board and bring back what it asks for.

example_proving.done_log: You brought it back. The clerk looked almost impressed.

example_welcome.title: A note
pages: Pinned to the door of the guild hall, with your name on it:

pages.speaker: Erþel Clerk Hunters
pages.text: Come and find me when you've a moment, {given}. Nothing urgent. Probably.

choices.text: Go and see what the clerk wants.

example_found_key.title: The key
pages: Half buried in the leaf litter: an old iron key, just as the clerk described.

talk.reply: I dropped a key out at [Quiet][Green][Daybreak], the last time I went walking. Bring it back if you're out that way, would you?
My key! Thank you, {given}. Here, for your trouble.
The wild dogs at [Quiet][Green][Daybreak] are getting bold. Thin them out: three will do.

talk.text: Is there anything special for me?
talk.reply: There might be. I've posted something on the contracts board. Bring it back and we'll talk.

example_proving_hunt.title: The clerk's proving hunt
example_proving_hunt.description: The clerk wants an old brass device brought back from deep at [Restless][Green][Tusks]. Something large has made its home beside it.
done_text: The clerk turns the brass device over in their hands.
